channel.description: Internet trends, as seen by the Cloudflare global network.
channel.title: @radar.cloudflare.com - Cloudflare Radar

item.description:
ICY (somehow) MI, yesterday the #GTAVI unlock took a lap of the planet 🌍🏁 Radar tracked DNS requests to 1.1.1.1 as the release rolled out and here’s what we found.
DNS requests to Rockstar services spiked at local midnight time zone by time zone, from New Zealand to Mexico, over about 19 hours.

#Internet traffic from Salt (AS15796) in #Switzerland recovered around 23:00 UTC on Nov 18 after a fixed-line disruption that began around 19:15 UTC and cut traffic by up to 43%.
More details on Cloudflare Radar: https://radar.cloudflare.com/traffic/as15796?dateStart=2026-11-18&dateEnd=2026-11-19

🚨 Following overnight Russian strikes on energy infrastructure that reportedly cut power to more than 600,000 consumers in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, http requests from the region dropped by around 20%, starting 03:15 UTC.
More details: https://radar.cloudflare.com/traffic/709929?dateStart=2026-11-07&dateEnd=2026-11-08

A power plant failure at WEB Aruba caused an island-wide blackout in #Aruba, disrupting #Internet traffic on SETAR (AS11816), the island's main telecom provider. Traffic dropped by as much as 68% at 18:00 UTC (14:00 local), recovering by ~20:15 UTC.
Follow: https://radar.cloudflare.com/traffic/aw?dateStart=2026-11-05&dateEnd=2026-11-06

🚨 Orange (AS3215) in #France is experiencing a mobile network outage since 09:30 UTC on October 21. #Internet
Follow the latest on Cloudflare Radar: https://radar.cloudflare.com/explorer?dataSet=http&timeCompare=1&asn=3215&filters=deviceType%253DMOBILE&dateStart=2026-10-19&dateEnd=2026-10-21

📡Cloudflare Radar’s redesign is live! ✨ We've completely updated the landing page to make global Internet data easier to explore for broader audiences.
🔎 Explore the new look: radar.cloudflare.com 👀 Read the blog post: blog.cloudflare.com/radar-redesign http://radar.cloudflare.com

Damage to two fiber optic cables on Route Nationale #1 in #Haiti caused a complete #Internet outage on Digicel (AS27653), the country's largest mobile operator. Traffic dropped to zero at ~13:45 UTC on Oct 3 and remained down for nearly 28 hours.
Radar: https://radar.cloudflare.com/traffic/as27653?dateStart=2026-10-02&dateEnd=2026-10-04

👀 Certificates logged for .si domains, Slovenia’s country-code top-level domain, have increased over the past few days, coinciding with the White House announcement that “Artificial Intelligence” (#AI) should be replaced with “Super Intelligence” (#SI).
https://radar.cloudflare.com/explorer?dataSet=ct&filters=uniqueEntries%253Dtrue%252Ctld%253Dsi&dt=28d#result

🚨 Evidence of disruptions in Russia’s Far East, including Chukotka, Magadan Oblast, Kamchatka, and Sakhalin Oblast, following nationwide elections held this past weekend and reports of a cable cut.
👀 Follow along on Radar: https://radar.cloudflare.com/traffic/2121529
